title: Learn the venture's services and engagements
goal: Every service the venture sells is an offer, every running engagement has its deliverables with an acceptance test each, and every unsigned statement of work is named.

steps.do: Read the service offers, engagements, customers and handoffs, and list what is missing, most needed first.

Ask the founder which services the venture sells, with the outcome, what each includes and excludes and how it is priced, and draft one offer per service; any new or retired offer goes to the founder.

consider.why: Each service the venture sells needs its scope and price written down.
consider.when: The business is in Beachhead or later, or the venture already sells a service.

steps.do: Ask which client engagements are running or signed, and write one engagement each with its deliverables, due dates and the acceptance test for each deliverable.

consider.why: Running engagements carry deliverables and dates the venture must meet.
consider.when: The business is in Beachhead or later, or a client engagement is running or signed.

steps.do: Open a handoff for each deliverable due in the next two weeks, with the acceptance test as its done criteria, and list it on the engagement.

consider.why: Deliverables due soon need someone working on them.
consider.when: The business is in Beachhead or later (handoffs from Validation), or an engagement has a deliverable due in the next two weeks.

steps.do: Tell the founder in one message which engagements run, what is due in the next two weeks, every deliverable without an acceptance test and any unsigned statement of work, raising the order of work to the product lead.

done_criteria.check: Does every deliverable of every active engagement have an acceptance test the client can apply?
